messages:
sophia: Heads-up: scheduled release freeze next Wed 20:00-23:00 UTC for an emergency security patch. All non-critical deploys please hold. We'll run canaries + controlled rollout after the patch. :lock:

deploy-bot: [maintenance] Window scheduled by @sophia: 2026-04-01 20:00-23:00 UTC. Auto-blocking deploys with tag `deploy:unstable`.

mike: Quick q — how do teams request an exemption for an urgent customer hotfix?

sophia: Exemptions allowed only for verified customer-impacting hotfixes. Fill the small form and ping `#release-ops` with the ticket link. Required fields: PR link, rollback plan, expected downtime. Approvals from release-ops + security.

devon: Rollback plan note: set `rollback_window=30m` in the deploy config and keep canary weight at 5% -> steady -> 25% if healthy. If latency spike, abort and roll back immediately.

yusuf: Ops ask: please tag observability spans with `maintenance_window:true` when you run the post-patch smoke tests so we can filter metrics.

oncall-bot: Reminder queued: oncall rotation alert 30m before window. If you plan to be offline, mark `oncall:coverage` in the roster.

sophia: Action items for teams: 1) stop non-critical deploys into prod after 18:00 UTC Wed; 2) ensure your canary config uses `max_canary_qps` and `rollback_window`; 3) if you need exemption, file form by Tue EOD. After patch, run the post-freeze checks:```./scripts/post-freeze-checks.sh --smoke --metrics```

release-ops: We'll run a staged rollout: canary nodes in us-west first, then eu-central. We'll post a live thread during the window with health markers. Ping us in-thread for immediate help. :satellite:

sophia: Thanks all — next update will be Monday with final checklist and ETA for the patch artifact. Triage channel: #release-ops. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: Release freeze announcement for emergency security patch with exemption process, canary guidance, rollback settings, tagging for observability, and follow-up actions.
